visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female creator with short brown hair is framed in a medium shot against a white floral wallpaper background. She wears a white oversized hoodie and a silver necklace. She smiles widely, revealing her teeth, while holding a pink-and-white beauty product package. The lighting is bright, even, and professional indoor lighting. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up shot focused on the product package. The packaging is cardboard with pink and white graphics, identifying the item as lower eyelash tattoo stickers. The woman's hands with manicured nails are seen holding the product steadily in front of the camera lens. (3) She presents the inner sheet of the product, which is white paper containing rows of tiny black eyelash patterns. She uses her fingers to indicate the different sections labeled for the left and right eyes, maintaining a friendly and helpful facial expression throughout the segment. (4) In a close-up framing, the creator uses a pair of small metal scissors to carefully cut out a single pair of eyelash stickers from the sheet. Her focus is intense, and the background remains the blurred floral wallpaper. No text is visible on this specific cut. (5) Using a pair of black tweezers, she delicately peels back the transparent plastic film from the small sticker cutout. Her movements are precise, and her hands are the central focus of the frame as she prepares the adhesive product for application on her skin. (6) The scene shifts back to a medium shot where she laughs enthusiastically. Digital graphics of pink flower petals fall from the top of the frame, adding a comedic and cheerful atmosphere. Her eyes are closed as she expresses genuine amusement while holding the tweezers. (7) She leans toward the camera to apply the wet tattoo sticker to her lower eyelid area. Her eyes are open and focused on an off-camera mirror. The lighting highlights the fine details of her skin and the placement of the sticker near her lash line. (8) A macro close-up of the woman's right eye reveals the applied sticker. The lashes appear dark and distinct against her lower lid. Ring light reflections are visible in her pupil. She blinks naturally to show how the sticker moves with her eyelid. (9) She uses a small, fluffy makeup brush to dab translucent powder over the applied tattoo. She looks to the side into a mirror, carefully checking the finish. This action is intended to reduce the synthetic shine of the sticker's adhesive layer for a more natural look. (10) Returning to the initial medium shot, she holds the product box next to her face. She talks animatedly to the camera, gesturing toward her eyes to show the final result. Her expression is positive and satisfied as she provides her concluding thoughts on the product.
